src.text:
INTRODUCTION (what the novel is, who wrote it, when):
Jurassic Park is a 1990 science fiction novel written by Michael Crichton. It is a cautionary tale about genetic engineering that depicts the collapse of a zoological park featuring genetically recreated dinosaurs, illustrating chaos theory and its real-world implications. Crichton published a sequel, The Lost World, in 1995.
Jurassic Park was adapted into a 1993 film directed by Steven Spielberg. The film achieved critical and commercial success, becoming the highest-grossing film of all time at the time of its release and launching the Jurassic Park franchise.

PLOT (an editor-reviewed concise summary of the whole story, 700 words; the ONLY source of the events):
In 1989, a series of unusual animal attacks occur in Costa Rica, with evidence suggesting the involvement of Procompsognathus, an extinct dinosaur. Paleontologist Alan Grant and his colleague, paleobotanist Ellie Sattler, meet with an EPA official to discuss the incidents but are unexpectedly summoned by John Hammond, a billionaire and founder of the bioengineering company InGen. Hammond takes them to Isla Nublar, a remote island where he has established a biological preserve, for a weekend visit.
The preserve is a cover for the construction of "Jurassic Park", a theme park showcasing living dinosaurs recreated using ancient DNA found in the blood inside insects that were fossilized and preserved in amber. Gaps in the genetic code were filled in with reptilian, avian, or amphibian DNA. To control breeding, the park's specimens are raised as females with a genetic flaw that makes them lysine deficient and unable to survive outside captivity.
The recent attacks have made Hammond's investors skittish. Hammond requests that Grant and Sattler tour the park and endorse it. They are joined by mathematician and chaos theorist Ian Malcolm, and a lawyer representing the investors, Donald Gennaro, both of whom are pessimistic about the park. Hammond also invites his grandchildren, Tim and Alexis 'Lex' Murphy, to join the tour. The park staff comprise senior engineer John Arnold, biotechnologist Henry Wu, game warden Robert Muldoon, PR director Ed Regis, chief programmer Dennis Nedry, veterinarian Harding, and several laborers. 
While touring the park, Grant finds a Velociraptor eggshell, seemingly proving Malcolm's assertion that the dinosaurs are breeding. Grant deduces that using frog DNA to fill gaps in the dinosaurs' genetic code resulted in an environment that was conducive to dichogamy; some of the female dinosaurs became males and established a breeding population. The park's automated tally system failed to account for the newborns, having been programmed to allow operators to input the expected number of dinosaurs.
Nedry, angered by Hammond refusing to pay him for months of overwork, commits corporate espionage for Lewis Dodgson, an employee of InGen's rival, Biosyn. Activating a backdoor he wrote into the park's software, he disables the security systems and steals frozen embryos for the park's dinosaur species. Attempting to rendezvous with Dodgson's agent, he becomes lost due to a tropical storm. Nedry's sabotage disables the electric fences around the park's enclosures. He is killed by a Dilophosaurus during his attempted escape.
The tour group discovers that dinosaurs have escaped the island by stowing away on supply boats. When the power is turned off, they are left stranded next to the Tyrannosaurus rex enclosure and a Tyrannosaurus rex attacks them. Grant rescues Tim and Lex, but Malcolm is severely injured and left behind, while Regis is eaten. Muldoon and Gennaro, searching for the tour group, find Malcolm and leave him in Harding's care.
Arnold tries rebooting the control room's systems and undoing Nedry's sabotage while repair crews patch up the park. However, the staff does not realize that the rebooting process has left the main generators turned off, leaving only the overtaxed auxiliary generator operational. It quickly breaks down, disabling the entire island's power. Velociraptors escape their enclosure and kill Arnold and Wu. Grant and the children make their way back to the island's control complex by rafting down a river, narrowly escaping multiple dinosaur attacks. 
Grant and Tim restart the main generators and regain control of the park's systems. Warned by Grant that raptors are aboard, Gennaro contacts the island's departing supply ship and recalls it. Hammond, walking outdoors while contemplating InGen's future, is killed by a pack of Procompsognathus after falling down a hill and breaking his ankle. Grant, Sattler, Muldoon, and Gennaro search for the surviving raptors and discover a nest hidden in the park's waterworks.
Malcolm seemingly dies from his injuries. Everyone is evacuated by the Air Vigilance Service, which declares the dinosaurs hazardous and razes the island with napalm. The survivors are detained in a Costa Rican hotel. Weeks later, Grant is visited by Dr. Martin Gutierrez, an American doctor who lives in Costa Rica. Gutierrez informs Grant that an unknown pack of animals is migrating through the Costa Rican jungle, implying that the surviving dinosaurs have been reintroduced into Earth's ecosystem.

SIGNIFICANCE (themes, reception, legacy: use ONLY for the closing wrap-up, to say why the novel matters):
[Themes]
Jurassic Park critiques the dystopian potentialities of modern science. Ian Malcolm is the conscience that reminds John Hammond of the immoral and unnatural path that has been taken. The final condition of the park is epitomized by the word "hell" which highlights the sacrilegious nature of Hammond's attempt.
The plot of Crichton's novel has similarities to Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus, where humanity creates something without truly knowing anything about it. Henry Wu is unable to name the things that he creates, which alludes to Victor Frankenstein not knowing what to call his flawed imitation of God's creation. The immorality of these actions lead to human destruction, echoing the creature's vengeance on his creator.

[Reception]
The book became a bestseller and Crichton's signature novel, with largely favorable reviews by critics. In a review for The New York Times, Christopher Lehmann-Haupt described it as "a superior specimen of the [Frankenstein] myth" and "easily the best of Mr. Crichton's novels to date". Writing for Entertainment Weekly, Gene Lyons held that the book was "hard to beat for sheer intellectual entertainment" largely because it was "[f]illed with diverting, up-to-date information in easily digestible form". scenes.narration_fa: رمان علمی‌تخیلی Jurassic Park در سال هزار و نهصد و نود به قلم Michael Crichton نوشته شد. این داستان هشداردهنده درباره مهندسی ژنتیک، فروپاشی یک پارک زیست‌شناختی با دایناسورهای بازسازی‌شده را نشان می‌دهد. نویسنده در این اثر، نظریه آشوب و پیامدهای واقعی آن را به تصویر می‌کشد تا داستان به ماجرایی هیجان‌انگیز تبدیل شود.

scenes.action_en: An artistically framed introduction depicting a glowing amber mosquito against scientific monitors.

Bright fluorescent ceiling lighting illuminates the high-tech lab interior, revealing glass petri dishes, stainless steel instruments, a laboratory centrifuge, and sealed glass vials filled with golden yellow liquids.

Wide establishing shot of a futuristic park control room featuring wall-sized green vector radar screens and flickering warning consoles. Dark nighttime ambiance fills the room, casting shadows across scattered paper computer printouts, bulky CRT displays, high-backed swivel chairs, abandoned coffee mugs, and dark steel spiral staircases in the background.

They stand on a green lawn landing pad, bathed in warm late afternoon sun. In the background are lush tropical palm trees, duffel bags on turf, windswept grass, and misty mountain peaks.

Sunlit daytime light shines through the windows as they travel past dense tropical jungle foliage, featuring leather interior seats, dashboard monitoring screens, heavy steel fence cables, and lush roadside greenery.

scenes.action_en: Alan Grant kneels down in the foliage, carefully holding a hatched Velociraptor eggshell while examining it with intense focus.

beat_visuals.visual_en: Close-up of automated mechanical metal arms delicately handling transparent glass incubator tubes containing dinosaur embryos inside a cleanroom laboratory. Bright blue fluorescent lighting reflects off stainless steel racks, frosted glass partition windows, digital temperature dials, white clinical countertops, and sterile plastic trays.

Filtered mid-day sunlight cuts through the thick green forest canopy overhead, highlighting wild fern fronds, damp fallen leaves, muddy earth, mossy tree roots, and dense tropical foliage.

Terrifying dark stormy night atmosphere with rain pouring down, flashing orange emergency lights, muddy road puddles, broken metal fence posts, and towering jungle trees.

Close-up of a mathematician resting against a muddy earth bank while clutching his bandaged leg in pain. Torrential rain pours down in the dim blue night, showing rain droplets on round wire-rimmed glasses, wet palm fronds, muddy water puddles, discarded torn cloth, and dark wet jungle roots.

scenes.narration_fa: کارکنان سعی می‌کنند سیستم‌های کنترل را دوباره راه‌اندازی کنند، اما ژنراتورهای اصلی خاموش می‌مانند. با از کار افتادن ژنراتور کمکی، برق کل جزیره قطع می‌شود و دایناسورهای Velociraptor از حصار فرار می‌کنند. در نتیجه این اتفاق، چند نفر کشته می‌شوند و Alan Grant همراه کودکان با قایق از مسیر رودخانه فرار می‌کند.
scenes.source_en: However, the staff does not realize that the rebooting process has left the main generators turned off... Velociraptors escape their enclosure... Grant and the children make their way back... by rafting down a river...
scenes.setting_en: A misty, dangerous jungle riverbank in the early dawn light.
scenes.action_en: Alan Grant guides a wooden raft down a turbulent river with Tim Murphy, navigating away from dense foliage where raptors lurk.
scenes.spoken_fa: کارْکُنان سَعْی می‌کُنَند سِیستِم‌هایِ کُنْتُرُل را دُوبارِه راه‌اَندازی کُنَند، اَما ژِنِراتُورهایِ اَصْلی خامُوش می‌مانَند. با اَز کار اُفْتادَنِ ژِنِراتُورِ کُمَکی، بَرْقِ کُلِّ جَزیرِه قَطْع می‌شَوَد وَ دایِناسُورهایِ Velociraptor اَز حِصار فَرار می‌کُنَند. دَر نَتیجِهٔ اِین اِتِّفاق، چَنْد نَفَر کُشْتِه می‌شَوَند وَ Alan Grant هَمْراهِ کُودَکان با قایِق اَز مَسیرِ رُودخانِه فَرار می‌کُنَد.

در نتیجه این اتفاق، چند نفر کشته می‌شوند و Alan Grant همراه کودکان با قایق از مسیر رودخانه فرار می‌کند.

beat_visuals.visual_en: Silhouette against the light of predatory velociraptors perching atop a broken wire mesh enclosure fence. Gloomy misty dawn breaking over the jungle creates stark light behind the creatures, casting fog around tall palm trees, a forgotten searchlight beam, scattered steel debris, and dense tropical rainforest plants.

Medium shot of a man paddling a yellow rubber raft down a turbulent jungle river while a young boy sits at the front. Early morning hazy sunlight illuminates the scene, revealing overhanging jungle branches, white river rapids foam, slippery shoreline boulders, dense bamboo thickets, and misty water spray.

scenes.narration_fa: سرانجام Alan Grant و Tim موفق می‌شوند ژنراتور اصلی را روشن کنند و کنترل سیستم‌های پارک را به دست گیرند. در همین حین، John Hammond هنگام قدم زدن سقوط می‌کند و توسط دسته‌ای از دایناسورهای کوچک کشته می‌شود. پس از آن، Alan Grant و سایر بازماندگان به جستجوی آشیانه دایناسورها می‌پردازند.
scenes.source_en: Grant and Tim restart the main generators and regain control of the park's systems... Hammond, walking outdoors... is killed by a pack of Procompsognathus after falling down a hill...
scenes.setting_en: Industrial basement generator control room of the main complex, flickering fluorescent lighting.
scenes.action_en: Alan Grant and Tim Murphy pull heavy industrial breakers on a main power panel to restart the island systems.
scenes.spoken_fa: سرانجام Alan Grant و Tim موفق می‌شوند ژنراتور اصلی را روشن کنند و کنترل سیستم‌های پارک را به دست گیرند. در همین حین، John Hammond هنگام قدم زدن سقوط می‌کند و توسط دسته‌ای از دایناسورهای کوچک کشته می‌شود. پس از آن، Alan Grant و سایر بازماندگان به جستجوی آشیانه دایناسورها می‌پردازند.

beat_visuals.visual_en: Low-angle shot of an elderly man tumbling down a steep grassy hill, dropping his polished wooden cane in the grass. Daytime light under overcast gray skies exposes small lizard-like creatures swarming through tall weeds around him, alongside loose rocks, fallen tropical palm fronds, and wet muddy slopes.

Over-the-shoulder shot looking past a male paleontologist and a female paleobotanist peering into a subterranean cave holding dinosaur nests. Twin bright flashlight beams pierce through damp cavern mist, revealing ancient jagged rock walls, sandy floor nests filled with eggs, dripping stalactites, and dark rocky crevices.

scenes.narration_fa: در جمع‌بندی، این داستان مسیر فروپاشی یک رویا را از آغاز تا فاجعه نهایی به تصویر می‌کشد. با بحرانی شدن اوضاع، نیروهای هوایی تمام نجات‌یافتگان را از جزیره تخلیه می‌کنند و منطقه را با بمب‌های ناپالم به آتش می‌کشند. بدین ترتیب رویای پرهزینه ساخت پارک زیستی به یک کابوس تمام‌عیار تبدیل می‌شود.
scenes.source_en: Everyone is evacuated by the Air Vigilance Service, which declares the dinosaurs hazardous and razes the island with napalm.
scenes.setting_en: View from an airborne evacuation helicopter looking back down at Isla Nublar at dusk.
scenes.action_en: Alan Grant and Ellie Sattler look out the window of a military helicopter as fiery napalm explosions consume the jungle island below.
scenes.spoken_fa: دَر جَمْع‌بَندی، اِین داسْتان مَسیرِ فَرُوپاشیِ یِک رُویا را اَز آغاز تا فاجِعِهٔ نَهایی بِه تَصویر می‌کِشَد. با بُحْرانی شُدَنِ اَوضاع، نِیُرُوهایِ هَوایی تَمامِ نَجات‌یافْتِگان را اَز جَزیرِه تَخْلِیِه می‌کُنَند وَ مَنطَقِه را با بُمب‌هایِ ناپالْم بِه آتش می‌کِشَند. بَدِین تَرتیب رُویاِیِ پُرْهَزینِهٔ ساختِ پارْکِ زِیستی بِه یِک کابُوسِ تَمام‌عَیار تَبدیل می‌شَوَد.
beats: در جمع‌بندی، این داستان مسیر فروپاشی یک رویا را از آغاز تا فاجعه نهایی به تصویر می‌کشد. با بحرانی شدن اوضاع، نیروهای هوایی تمام نجات‌یافتگان را از جزیره تخلیه می‌کنند و منطقه را با بمب‌های ناپالم به آتش می‌کشند.
بدین ترتیب رویای پرهزینه ساخت پارک زیستی به یک کابوس تمام‌عیار تبدیل می‌شود.

beat_visuals.visual_en: Wide establishing shot from inside a military helicopter looking down at the tropical island of Isla Nublar below. Dusk sunlight glows on the horizon as massive plumes of orange fire and dark smoke rise from burning jungle foliage, framed by the helicopter door, ocean waves, and military gear straps.

Silhouette against the light of a destroyed visitor center entrance gate against a dramatic smoky sunset. Glowing embers drift across charred mud ground, casting harsh shadows behind dark skeletal palm trees, broken wooden fencing, ruined stone pillars, and torn park banners blowing in the hot wind.

scenes.narration_fa: رمان Jurassic Park نقد روشنی بر پیامدهای علم مدرن و غرور انسان است. در این داستان Ian Malcolm نماد وجدان بیداری است که رفتار غیراخلاقی را به John Hammond یادآوری می‌کند. این اثر با الهام از داستان فرانکنشتاین نشان می‌دهد که آفرینش ناآگاهانه موجودات توسط انسان، در نهایت به نابودی آفریننده ختم خواهد شد.
scenes.source_en: Jurassic Park critiques the dystopian potentialities of modern science. Ian Malcolm is the conscience that reminds John Hammond of the immoral and unnatural path... The plot... has similarities to Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein...
scenes.setting_en: Abstract philosophical space contrasting futuristic high-tech DNA labs with dark gothic shadows.
scenes.action_en: Ian Malcolm standing thoughtfully, gesturing as if arguing a moral point, framed by complex mathematical chaos theory graphics.
scenes.spoken_fa: رُمانِ Jurassic Park نَقْدِ رُوشَنی بَر پَیامَدهایِ عِلْمِ مُدِرْن وَ غُرُورِ اِنْسان اَست. دَر اِین داسْتان Ian Malcolm نَمادِ وِجْدانِ بیداری اَست کِه رَفْتارِ غَیْرِاَخْلاقی را بِه John Hammond یادآوَری می‌کُنَد. اِین اَثَر با اِلْهام اَز داسْتانِ فِرانْکِنِشْتاین نِشان می‌دَهد کِه آفَرینِشِ ناآگاهانِهٔ مَوجُودات تَوَسُّطِ اِنْسان، دَر نِهایَت بِه نابُودیِ آفَرینَندِه خَتْم خواهَد شُد.
beats: رمان Jurassic Park نقد روشنی بر پیامدهای علم مدرن و غرور انسان است. در این داستان Ian Malcolm نماد وجدان بیداری است که رفتار غیراخلاقی را به John Hammond یادآوری می‌کند.
این اثر با الهام از داستان فرانکنشتاین نشان می‌دهد که آفرینش ناآگاهانه موجودات توسط انسان، در نهایت به نابودی آفریننده ختم خواهد شد.

beat_visuals.visual_en: Medium shot of a mathematician gesturing intently while speaking across a formal white-clothed dining table to an elderly man. Warm indoor chandelier lighting illuminates the visitor center dining hall, showing crystal wine glasses, polished silverware, half-eaten meals, dark wooden chairs, and colorful tropical murals on walls.

Detail shot of an object showing a broken glass petri dish cracked open on a wet concrete floor. Harsh cold spotlighting highlights green fluorescent liquid leaking across dark damp stone, alongside metallic lab debris, shattered beaker shards, small claw prints in nearby mud, and discarded scientific cables.

scenes.narration_fa: در نهایت، هفته‌ها بعد Alan Grant مطلع می‌شود که جانورانی ناشناخته در جنگل‌های کوستاریکا در حال حرکت هستند. این موضوع نشان می‌دهد دایناسورها وارد چرخه طبیعی زمین شده‌اند. این کتاب با استقبال گرم منتقدان روبه‌رو شد و به عنوان یکی از برترین آثار Michael Crichton باقی ماند.
scenes.source_en: Gutierrez informs Grant that an unknown pack of animals is migrating through the Costa Rican jungle, implying that the surviving dinosaurs have been reintroduced into Earth's ecosystem.
scenes.setting_en: A quiet Costa Rican hotel porch overlooking a dense, mist-covered tropical mainland forest weeks later.
scenes.action_en: Alan Grant stands looking at the distant misty jungle line with a deep, knowing look of wonder and concern.

beat_visuals.visual_en: Over-the-shoulder shot looking over a male paleontologist standing on a wooden hotel balcony holding a paper letter. Late afternoon golden sunlight illuminates the vast mainland Costa Rican rainforest in the background, featuring a rustic wicker balcony chair, ceramic coffee mug, wooden railing, and distant mist-covered hills.

Close-up of an open hardcover novel lying on a dark wooden desk under the warm glow of a brass desk lamp. Cream-colored book pages display printed text, flanked by a vintage brass compass, leather notebook, round reading glasses, a polished wooden tabletop, and soft shadow backgrounds.

script.art_style_en: comic book illustration, thick black outlines, dynamic angles, bold shadows, halftone shading, saturated colors
script.era_en: Isla Nublar, Costa Rica, 1989. Clothing of that time: Late 1980s tropical island and expedition attire featuring lightweight cotton khaki shorts, breathable linen utility shirts, waterproof nylon rain jackets, durable canvas trousers, sturdy leather hiking boots, and sun protective hats.
